data.body: PHASE 1 RCA — macOS-to-Ubuntu routing. Proven mechanism: the four pytest matrix cells historically used the same selectors, so excluding a proven OS/Python-invariant node from macOS while retaining it in the existing Ubuntu 3.13 process removes duplicate work; it does not add a runner, checkout, install, pytest session, collection pass, or fixture scope. Change 1817 landed this exact route for 19 immutable repository text/AST policy nodes in origin/main commit 53efe2426e. Current-main proof: tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py passed 22 tests; the repo_policy selection passed its exact 19-node inventory in 16.43s locally. Ticket maize-wintery-larva measured about 8s expected macOS critical-path savings and 24.84 aggregate runner-seconds, with warm-state variation; no post-merge organic Verify run has been dispatched yet, so no post-change CI delta is claimed. The 25m53s run 31900214367 was pre-merge and therefore used the prior trusted-main reusable workflow. Discriminating evidence against broader routing: three recent successful runs had macOS default 1031.61-1446.74s and integration 103.36-140.38s, no visible phase above 30s, and top-25 entries explained only 14-16 percent of default wall. The local exhaustive default pass on c601fe739f was 13,503 passed / 25 skipped in 1538.21s; its sole 30.25s standalone-pytest node was below the 3.82-6.09s top-25 cutoff in each selected macOS CI run, so the local number is not a stable CI long pole. The exhaustive integration pass was 167 passed / 2 skipped in 105.99s; its slow tail was real import/commit, crash-resume, partial-clone, two-clone, lock, process, and Git behavior. Root-cause classification: repository text/AST duplication was a defect and is fixed; Git/concurrency/partial-clone, bare-pytest subprocess, and real OpenGrep/Gitleaks/ast-grep smoke tests are intended platform behavior and remain on macOS. Prior ticket crushable-choosable-llama classified those scanner/process cases as legitimate integration, while ropeable-hydrated-siskin preserves macOS behavioral coverage. New jobs/shards remain rejected by coercive-paediatric-bug because they repeat setup and increase runner contention. Any further node-level route requires repeated platform timings, proof of no native filesystem/Git/socket/subprocess/timeout/tool-discovery behavior, a collection oracle, a fault-seeded equivalence experiment, tracker rejection search, and OSS consensus. Ticket remains in progress for the broader over-one-second audit.
